FINAL SQL:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM (
    SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
) AS combined
GROUP BY AirportCode
ORDER BY SUM(cnt) ASC
LIMIT 1;
